nativeRefreshLatencyCorrection.mechanism: TreeView.message has no equality guard and shares a leading/trailing 200ms debounced event stream with row changes. Sidebar refresh rewrote unchanged messages before updateCues, opening the leading window with a message-only event and pushing rows to the trailing edge.
nativeRefreshLatencyCorrection.fix: The provider writes message and description only when their values actually differ. No private API, threshold change, timer abstraction or suppression of required pending/refusal cues is introduced.
nativeRefreshLatencyCorrection.hostRegression: sidebar-loading adds a real SidebarHostContext contract with spied TreeViews: identical refreshes write neither property, state transitions still update them, current rows route, and pre-switch rows still refuse as stale.
nativeRefreshLatencyCorrection.verification: The new host regression and real timing threshold need the next serialized compile/build/installed run. No improved latency measurement is claimed yet.

installedStructureInitialRun.observed: Both fail at designerFrame after 60000ms. The retained screenshot shows the report open in Text Editor, the native sidebar populated, and no designer webview.
installedStructureInitialRun.rootCause: The shared openReport test helper assumes Quick Open chooses the custom editor. Actual installed behavior chooses the XML text editor. US1 already explicitly invokes the public Open Designer command.
installedStructureInitialRun.correction: openReport now invokes RDLC Code: Open Designer after openFile, before focusing Report Structure and waiting for the frame. No product association or timeout is changed.

rerun.observed: Both now open the designer and reach actual assertions. US2.1 observes a bottom-window endpoint of 14 rather than the oracle's 27 after End; US2.2's centering probe cannot find Title although earlier selection assertions pass.
rerun.followUp: The trace proves End reached the bottom: four sticky ancestor clones appended after the actual list made the contiguous-window offset -1 (15 nodes yielded -1+15=14). The test now reads actual monaco-list-rows, retaining all 27 oracle entries. The canvas uses aria-label Title: Hello & welcome rather than the name-only string; the geometry probe now recognizes that real label and waits for known bounds. Native keys and folds still use real input.

installedContextNoticeRerun.observed: The scoped notice passes. The test later clicks Code XML on Group: Details but no source-editor status range appears; the screenshot still shows that context menu open.
installedContextNoticeRerun.rootCause: Pinned VS Code source arms menu mouseup handlers 100ms after render. This click starts 0.5ms after right-click; the successful preceding Table Delete starts at 124ms. The handler is not yet armed in the failed click, so no command dispatch starts.
installedContextNoticeRerun.correction: Each menu activation uses one pointer gesture held for 250ms, then requires the context menu to dismiss. No action retry, fake dispatch or keyboard replacement is used. Code XML current-range assertions remain unchanged; the fresh rerun is in progress.

menuArmingRerun.observed: Code XML now opens the source editor and the retained screenshot shows exactly Ln 10, Col 310 (23 selected). The test's obsolete .editor-status-selection class matches no element.
menuArmingRerun.correction: Require the exact same line, column and selected length via visible text within the actual statusbar. No substring or tolerance substitutes for the complete current-range oracle.
menuArmingRerun.rerun: In progress with separate menu-oracles artifacts.
